subject: Pilot scope change: prioritization matrix, success metrics, and owners
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Green <amanda@ellumretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot scope change: prioritization matrix, success metrics, and owners

Amanda / Carlos — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the asks we agreed to capture so the pilot (30-day) remains actionable: 

Summary of scope change (agreed on call):
- Primary focus: "Site search answer quality" for top-10 product queries (Use Case A)
- Secondary: "Category navigation suggestions" as experimental (Use Case B) — reduced to a single test cohort instead of full-store rollout
- Deprioritized: voice-search integration for this pilot (will revisit Q3)

Immediate asks / deliverables (action owners in parentheses):
1) Prioritization matrix (attached) — confirms the above and shows impact vs effort (Vivek)
2) Success metrics draft for each use case (Marissa) — we need KPIs by Friday
3) Data & security checklist for the experiment (Neha) — procurement contacts copied for any evidence requests
4) Proposed evaluation cadence and gating criteria (Ben)

Attachments: pilot-prioritization-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Next steps before we kick off:
- Amanda to confirm two sample query cohorts and provide a data drop (examples + expected answers) by Tue 5/11
- Redwood to provide evaluation plan & ownership by Fri 5/13
- Short 30-min alignment next week to lock timeline (suggest Wed 5/12)

Thanks — I can host the alignment meeting.

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

From: Amanda Green <amanda@ellumretail.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Diaz <carlos.diaz@ellumretail.com>, procurement@ellumretail.com
Date: 2027-05-10T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot scope change: prioritization matrix, success metrics, and owners

Vivek — thanks for the clear recap. Quick notes: 

- Confirmed: we'll send two sample cohorts by end of day Tuesday (5/11). Carlos will own the data extraction.
- Timeline change request: Our internal analytics sprint is being pushed one week; can we shift the evaluation window start by 7 days (so pilot runs 5/20–6/18 instead of 5/13–6/11)? We can still commit to the 30-day evaluation, just shifted.
- Procurement: forwarding contract owner for evidence requests (procurement@ellumretail.com). They may ask for the SOC2 + retention docs referenced on your call.

Also adding a note: is it possible to run a quick A/B with our current search for a single category subset first? That would reduce risk and help baseline performance.

Thanks — Amanda
Amanda Green
Director, Product — Ellum Retail
amanda@ellumretail.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Green <amanda@ellumretail.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T14:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot scope change: prioritization matrix, success metrics, and owners

Amanda — appreciate the A/B idea, yes that fits our smaller-cohort approach. Draft KPIs and evaluation cadence below; sending evaluation-plan-v2.pdf to the Drive link in a follow-up.

Draft success metrics (Use Case A - Site search answer quality):
- Primary KPI: Top-10 precision@k (k=3) improvement of >= 12% over baseline
- Secondary KPIs: click-through rate (CTR) lift on organic results >= 8%, average session time increase 10–15s
- Guardrail: no negative impact on conversion rate beyond -1%

Use Case B (Category nav suggestions):
- Primary KPI: suggestion acceptance rate >= 6% for test cohort
- Secondary: time-to-first-click decrease >= 5s for sessions in cohort

Evaluation cadence & gating:
- Week 0 (setup): data handoff + baseline run (Carlos + Redwood infra)
- Week 1–4: experiment (rolling start once data is in); daily health checks, weekly KPI snapshots
- Gating at day 14: if primary KPI delta < 5% and no signal of upward trend, pause and run expanded cohort analysis

Owners:
- Experiment implementation & infra: Ben Carter
- KPI definitions & dashboards: Marissa Cole
- Security & procurement liaison: Neha Kapoor

Attachments referenced: evaluation-plan-v2.pdf (outline on Drive)

I'll finalize the PDF and drop it in the Drive link by EOD. If we agree on a shifted start (Amanda), Ben and I will adjust the rollout plan.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Green <amanda@ellumretail.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@ellumretail.com
Date: 2027-05-11T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot scope change: prioritization matrix, success metrics, and owners

Amanda / Vivek — quick security/compliance points to avoid delays during procurement: 

1) Evidence needs: SOC 2 Type II report (latest), data retention policy, and a short network diagram for the pilot traffic flow. We can provide redacted logs for the evaluation window if needed.
2) Data access: for the test cohort please share only hashed PII and the minimal query context needed to compute metrics (examples are fine).
3) Mid-trial acceptance change: we can accommodate re-baselining but we require a documented change request (email thread + updated acceptance matrix). Any mid-trial acceptance reset will be marked and timestamped in the evaluation report.

Procurement: please advise on any additional folders/links you need; we can centralize artifacts in the Drive link.

--
Neha Kapoor
Information Security — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Green <amanda@ellumretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot scope change: prioritization matrix, success metrics, and owners

Thanks all — locking the plan and next steps below after reviewing notes: 

1) Timeline: shifting pilot start to 2027-05-20 (per Amanda) — pilot run 2027-05-20 to 2027-06-18.
2) Deliverables by Redwood this week (owners):
   - Final evaluation-plan-v2.pdf + dashboard templates (Marissa) — due 2027-05-13 EOD
   - Deployment runbook + A/B test config for single category cohort (Ben) — due 2027-05-14
   - SOC2 + retention docs + network diagram (Neha) — shared to Drive by 2027-05-13
3) Customer deliverables:
   - Data drop (sample cohorts + expected answers) (Amanda/Carlos) — due 2027-05-11 (if delayed please notify Vivek)
   - Procurement redlines/questions to procurement@ellumretail.com

Mutual action plan:
- Wed 5/13 10:00 PT: 30-min alignment (calendar invite sent) — quick run through artifacts and owners
- Tue 5/19 11:00 PT: pre-start check (data verified + infra smoke test)

If anyone needs to change an acceptance criterion mid-run we'll use the documented change request process (reply-all with the reason + indicator of which KPI is changing). Marissa will track any such change in the evaluation-plan PDF version history.

Thanks — I'll send the calendar invites and drop the attachments into the Drive folder.
